answer: The walnut schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the quartz checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 81 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Someone wanting 62 effective identities must lock that capital for 81 epochs and keep it locked through every summit audit. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
